title: Seoul, US making progress on OPCON transfer talks despite concerns over delay: security chief
caption:
South Korea says progress is being made on taking wartime control of U.S. troops. The goal is to finish the handover before President Lee’s term ends, though delays remain possible. Follow the evolving security talks.

Source: Koreaherald - Seoul, US making progress on OPCON transfer talks despite concerns over delay: security chief
